description: Ask HomeMaster a question about its services and policies (what a clean includes, supplies, pets, cancelling or rescheduling, what to prepare). The answer comes only from HomeMaster's own service guide, the one Helen, our WhatsApp assistant, uses; `answered_from_guide` is false when the guide does not cover it. Slower than the other tools (up to about 20 seconds). Not for prices or times: use get_quote and find_times. The guide covers home cleaning and aircon servicing only. It does not know the services under more_services: if it says a job is not offered or goes on a waitlist, find_services is right, so call find_services with that service's code instead.
name: ask_homemaster
title: Ask about policies and what's included
